title: Norm additive mappings between the positive cones of continuous function algebras
summary: We study bijections between the positive cones of spaces of continuous functions vanishing at infinity that satisfy a norm additive condition. Such maps arise naturally in the study of nonlinear functional equations and norm-preserving structures on function spaces. While in the compact (unital) case these maps can often be analyzed via linear extension techniques, the non-unital setting $C_0(X)$ requires a different approach due to the absence of a distinguished unit element.
